mapper.sql: select rank_id, script_id, user_id, wx_openid, nickname, avatar_url, actor_name, ending_id, ending_title, ending_badge, quality_score, box_office, choice_path, status, del_flag, create_time, update_time from dj_leaderboard
mapper.select: where script_id = #{scriptId} and wx_openid = #{wxOpenid} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into dj_leaderboard( script_id, user_id, wx_openid, nickname, avatar_url, actor_name, ending_id, ending_title, ending_badge, quality_score, box_office, choice_path, status, del_flag, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{scriptId}, #{userId}, #{wxOpenid}, #{nickname}, #{avatarUrl}, #{actorName}, #{endingId}, #{endingTitle}, #{endingBadge}, #{qualityScore}, #{boxOffice}, #{choicePath}, '0', '0', sysdate(), sysdate() )
mapper.update: update dj_leaderboard set nickname = #{nickname}, actor_name = #{actorName}, ending_id = #{endingId}, ending_title = #{endingTitle}, ending_badge = #{endingBadge}, quality_score = #{qualityScore}, box_office = #{boxOffice}, choice_path = #{choicePath}, update_time = sysdate() where rank_id = #{rankId} and del_flag = '0'
update dj_leaderboard set status = #{status}, update_time = sysdate() where rank_id = #{rankId} and del_flag = '0'
update dj_leaderboard set actor_name = #{defaultName}, update_time = sysdate() where rank_id = #{rankId} and del_flag = '0'
